content.thinking:
My plan for the 'web' (tcp) service produced send=[...] with 2 entries — because `probe_script('web')` was called with the service *id* instead of the kind! In `solve`, I do `kind=offers[offer_id]['service']` which is the service ID ('web'), not the kind ('tcp'). I need `context['services'][service]` to get the kind.

Let me fix that.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
src=open('planning.py').read()
src=src.replace("            kind=offers[offer_id]['service']",
                "            kind=context['services'][offers[offer_id]['service']]")
open('planning.py','w').write(src)
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 tmp/run_check.py
